build.beforeDevCommand: npm --prefix ../.. run build:packages && npm --prefix ../.. run dev -w @relaydeck/client
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm --prefix ../.. run build:packages && npm --prefix ../.. run build -w @relaydeck/client

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws: wss:; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: 局域网共享浏览器控制客户端
bundle.longDescription: 通过局域网连接 Relaydeck 网关，安全控制服务器上的共享 Chrome 会话。
